name: Financial Instrument 96
definition: Security that is a sub-set of an investment fund, and is governed by the same investment fund policy, for example, dividend option or valuation currency.

PhysicalBearerSecurities.name: Physical Bearer Securities
PhysicalBearerSecurities.definition: Indicates whether it is possible to hold bearer units/shares in this class in certified form.

DematerialisedBearerSecurities.name: Dematerialised Bearer Securities
DematerialisedBearerSecurities.definition: Indicates whether it is possible to hold bearer units/shares in paperless form.

PhysicalRegisteredSecurities.name: Physical Registered Securities
PhysicalRegisteredSecurities.definition: Indicates whether it is possible to hold registered units/shares in this class in paperless form.

DematerialisedRegisteredSecurities.name: Dematerialised Registered Securities
DematerialisedRegisteredSecurities.definition: Indicates whether it is possible to hold registered units/shares in this class in paperless form.

DistributionPolicy.name: Distribution Policy
DistributionPolicy.definition: Income policy relating to the class type, that is, if income is paid out or retained in the fund.

DividendPolicy.name: Dividend Policy
DividendPolicy.definition: Dividend policy of the fund, for example, cash, units.

DividendFrequency.name: Dividend Frequency
DividendFrequency.definition: Frequency with which the income is allocated to investors.

ReinvestmentFrequency.name: Reinvestment Frequency
ReinvestmentFrequency.definition: Frequency with which the reinvestment takes place, this is the same or less than the dividend frequency.

FrontEndLoad.name: Front End Load
FrontEndLoad.definition: Indicates whether a front end charge on subscription orders for this class can be applied.

BackEndLoad.name: Back End Load
BackEndLoad.definition: Indicates whether an exit charge (for example, CDSC) on redemption orders for this class can be applied.

SwitchFee.name: Switch Fee
SwitchFee.definition: Indicates whether a separate fee for switching between sub-funds of the same umbrella can be applied.

EUSavingsDirective.name: EU Savings Directive
EUSavingsDirective.definition: Indicates whether the investment fund class is subject to the European Union Saving Directive.

LaunchDate.name: Launch Date
LaunchDate.definition: Date on which the fund is open for investment.

FundEndDate.name: Fund End Date
FundEndDate.definition: Date on which the fund is closed to investment.

InitialOfferEndDate.name: Initial Offer End Date
InitialOfferEndDate.definition: Date on which the discount period of the newly launched investment fund ends.

SuspensionStartDate.name: Suspension Start Date
SuspensionStartDate.definition: Date on which valuation of the investment fund class is suspended.

SuspensionEndDate.name: Suspension End Date
SuspensionEndDate.definition: Date on which valuation of the investment fund class is unsuspended.

MaturityDate.name: Maturity Date
MaturityDate.definition: Maturity date of the product. When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 00065.

MayBeTerminatedEarly.name: May Be Terminated Early
MayBeTerminatedEarly.definition: Specifies whether the product may be terminated early. When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 00067.

ClosedEndFund.name: Closed End Fund
ClosedEndFund.definition: Indicates whether the fund is close-ended.

TaxEfficientProductEligible.name: Tax Efficient Product Eligible
TaxEfficientProductEligible.definition: Indicates whether the fund is eligible for a tax efficient product.

Authorised.name: Authorised
Authorised.definition: Indicates whether the fund is authorised by the regulatory compliance authority.

RDRCompliant.name: RDR Compliant
RDRCompliant.definition: Indicates whether the fund is compliant with the Retail Distribution Review (RDR).

ManagementFeeSource.name: Management Fee Source
ManagementFeeSource.definition: Specifies from where the management fee is taken.

PerformanceFee.name: Performance Fee
PerformanceFee.definition: Indicates whether there is a performance fee feature or carried interest. When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 00045.
